question: Who among the following IPS officers in 2023 is one of the first women officers to become the Director General of police in Punjab?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shashi Prabha Dwivedi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shashi Prabha Dwivedi** became the** Director General of police **in **Punjab in 2023.**
 
• She is one of the **first women IPS officers** to achieve this position, making her a** trailblazer** for women in law enforcement in India.
 
• Senior IPS officer Shashi Prabha is from the **1993 batch. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Meera Chadha Borwankar** is also a **retired IPS officer** who served as the** Director General of the Bureau of Police Research and Development.**

 
 
• She has been widely recognized for her work in **police reforms and women's safety.**
 
 
 
• **Aparajita Rai** is a senior IPS officer who has served in various capacities in **Uttar Pradesh**, including as the Deputy Inspector General of Police in Lucknow.
 
 
• She is known for her work in** cybercrime** and has received several awards for her contributions to the field.
 
 
 
• **Ruveda Salam **is a young IPS officer from **Jammu and Kashmir** who has been hailed as a role model for young girls aspiring to join the police force.
 
 
• She is known for her work in **community policing** and has been recognized for her efforts to promote **gender equality and women's empowerment.**
